Spatial block folds of stations

Source: R/regionalize-cv.R
ef_spatial_folds.Rd

Deterministic folds for spatial block cross-validation (dev/specs/gwr-forcing.md section 8.2): each station is assigned to the square tile $$(i_x, i_y) = \left(\left\lfloor \frac{x - x_0}{L} \right\rfloor, \left\lfloor \frac{y - y_0}{L} \right\rfloor\right)$$ of side L = block_size [m] and origin \((x_0, y_0)\); every non-empty tile is a fold, numbered by \(i_y\) and then \(i_x\). No random numbers are used.

Usage

ef_spatial_folds(coords, block_size, origin = NULL)

Arguments

coords

Projected station coordinates [m]: a numeric matrix or data frame with two columns (x, y), optionally with the station identifiers as row names; a data frame with columns station_id, x and y (e.g. the station_table of an earthflux_surface); or a terra SpatVector of points (identifiers from its station_id attribute, if any).

block_size

Positive number: side L of the tiles [m], no default (to be justified with the scale of the autocorrelation of the residuals, decision GW-20).

origin

NULL or a numeric vector c(x0, y0) [m]; NULL uses the smallest x and y of the stations. Recorded in the result.

Value

An integer vector of folds, one per station (named by station when identifiers are available; a station listed more than once must have the same coordinates), with attributes block_size, origin and tile (data frame ix, iy).

Details

Errors: earthflux_input_error (coordinates not numeric or missing, inconsistent duplicates), earthflux_domain_error (non-positive or infinite block size).

References

Roberts, D. R., Bahn, V., Ciuti, S., Boyce, M. S., Elith, J., Guillera-Arroita, G., Hauenstein, S., Lahoz-Monfort, J. J., Schröder, B., Thuiller, W., Warton, D. I., Wintle, B. A., Hartig, F., & Dormann, C. F. (2017). Cross-validation strategies for data with temporal, spatial, hierarchical, or phylogenetic structure. Ecography, 40(8), 913-929. doi:10.1111/ecog.02881 (cited by the specification; not read).

See also

Other spatial regionalization functions: ef_gwr_bandwidth(), ef_gwr_diagnostics(), ef_gwr_fit(), ef_gwr_predict(), ef_gwr_search(), ef_method_gwr(), ef_method_idw(), ef_method_ols(), ef_method_station(), ef_predict_control(), ef_regionalize(), ef_regionalize_cv()

Examples

xy <- data.frame(station_id = c("A", "B", "C", "D"),
                 x = c(1000, 4000, 12000, 26000),
                 y = c(2000, 9000, 3000, 21000))
ef_spatial_folds(xy, block_size = 10000)
#> A B C D 
#> 1 1 2 3 
#> attr(,"block_size")
#> [1] 10000
#> attr(,"origin")
#>    x    y 
#> 1000 2000 
#> attr(,"tile")
#>   ix iy
#> 1  0  0
#> 2  0  0
#> 3  1  0
#> 4  2  1
